reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin for creating reusable multi-model agent teams, planning bounded workflows, executing member tasks, and inspecting runs and token usage.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可复用的多模型智能体团队，用于规划并执行有界工作流以及查看运行状态和令牌用量。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for creating reusable multi-model agent teams, executing bounded workflows, and inspecting run states and token usage.

capabilities: Plans and executes bounded dependency-graph workflows
Invokes configured per-agent models and tools
Runs foreground or background tasks with retries and quality-review stages
Stores run history, task content, handoffs, outputs, and token-usage data
Exports and imports team and member definitions
